name: Sheer Bloom
description: A matte lipstick bullet in a soft sheer dusty-rose shade, twisted up roughly two-thirds from a slim polished rose-gold cylindrical case, with its cap removed and set upright beside the open tube.
materials: Polished rose-gold plated metal case and cap, matte-finish pigmented lipstick bullet compound
primaryColors: Polished rose-gold metal, soft sheer dusty-rose bullet
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, wordmark, logo, printing, embossing, or engraving anywhere on the case or cap; never render a second cap or a second tube; never show the bullet retracted flush into the case or fully hidden; never let the cap touch, cover, or stack onto the open tube, keep them as two distinct separated pieces; no props, hands, or presenter in frame. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the cap and the open tube as two clearly separate upright pieces standing side by side in every angle, never one balanced on or covering the other, the bullet extended roughly two-thirds up from the case, and the polished rose-gold metal finish identical in color and reflectivity across every angle.
